candidate_sentence_map.S1: Talkpool reported a period of significant financial improvement and strategic transition in 2025, marking the end of its multi-year cost-reduction phase and the beginning of organic growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Net sales increased by 12.5 percent to EUR 17.8 million, up from EUR 15.8 million in the previous year.
